nodes.label: Pull Request Checks
nodes.rationale: Formatting, linting, type checking, tests, documentation builds, and changelog updates are requested before opening a pull request to speed review and preserve quality.

nodes.label: CMB Fisher Path
nodes.rationale: The current implementation applies one ell range to all CMB spectra; separate TT/TE/EE ranges and lensing spectra are not implemented.

nodes.label: FAST Photometric Paths
nodes.rationale: FAST enables optimized lensing-efficiency integration, vectorized Limber power spectra, and vectorized weak-lensing kernels; SLOW disables them as the baseline.
